resources.string: Everything COMMAND asks your consent for is listed here, with when it last changed and who changed it. Nothing else is switched on.
Only the features listed here ask for your consent in this version. When another one that needs its own consent arrives, it will be listed here before it can be used.
Android keeps this permission. COMMAND can only ask and show you the right screen.
Lets an alarm appear over the lock screen and leaves a note when one is missed.
Lets an alarm ring at the minute you set instead of at some point in a window.
Lets a ringing alarm take over a locked screen.
While an alarm rings, COMMAND may turn the alarm volume up so that you can hear it. It puts the volume back afterwards, unless you have changed it yourself in the meantime.
It never changes the ring or media volume. It changes the alarm volume only around an alarm: up when one starts to ring, and back when it stops.
This is yours to change here, at any time.
COMMAND reads the time and title of events in the calendars you choose, and sets an alarm for each.
It never changes your calendar, never reads event descriptions and sends nothing anywhere. Turning this off takes back the alarms for events that have not rung.
Scanning a code you registered when an alarm asks for it. Frames are read on the phone and never saved or sent.
It does not take photos or video.
